'''Geiz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Rishi]], he was part of [[Satele Shan]]'s force that traveled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and established the anti-[[Order of Revan|Revanite]] coalition along with Imperial forces under [[Darth Marr]]. In the area around the [[Temple of Sacrifice]] Geiz asked a fellow Coalition member to assist him in eliminating local predatory wildlife.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Geiz appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
